novelty_flags.one_line: DelaigleHallMeister2008 is a close published unknown-error repeated-measurement regression precursor but is absent from the related-work comparison; explicitly distinguish its replicated-error/nonzero-operator regime from the proposed asymmetric open-zero blind band.

source_verification_receipts.version: author-hosted manuscript inspected; corroborative rather than the cited EJS version
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2–3, Introduction and Theorem 1; p. 5, equation (3)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The manuscript assumes only independent error coordinates for identification, allows characteristic functions to vanish on open sets, identifies signal and errors up to translation under H2, and introduces a local positive characteristic-function modulus for rate control.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2, equation (1) and Assumption 1; lines 109–149 of the publisher rendering
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes classical treatment error independent of treatment/covariates, takes its characteristic function as known in the main setup, imposes unconfoundedness, consistency, and positivity, and identifies the ADRF through a weighted conditional expectation.
The paper constructs a uniform confidence band for a latent density from linear complex-valued Kotlarski moment restrictions, with uniform size control and fixed-alternative power.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv manuscript inspected; journal version is Journal of Econometrics 213 (2019), 516–555
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops asymptotically valid uniform confidence bands for EIV regression using multiplier bootstrap and permits an unknown error distribution when validation data or repeated measurements are available.

source_verification_receipts.version: author-hosted paper corresponding to Annals of Statistics 36(2) (2008), 665–685
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper treats density and regression deconvolution with repeated measurements and shows that modified estimators can attain first-order known-error performance under its replicate-error conditions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add DelaigleHallMeister2008 to related_work and the upper-band gap, stating precisely which of its replicate-error, symmetry/identical-law, and nonvanishing-operator conditions the blind open-zero construction removes.

State the quantitative compatibility requirements under which the fixed f0 and fixed errors belong to M (in particular f0 target positivity and both Sobolev-radius bounds), so the lower-bound subclass is visibly nonempty before the Legendre construction begins.

Give the upper and lower results a shared named minimax-width theorem statement tying r_n directly to the fixed blind-replicate ADRF class; this makes the matched field contribution more immediately legible than the current lemma-to-theorem chain.

recommended_next_step: Revise the published comparison to incorporate DelaigleHallMeister2008 and sharpen the explicit distinction; then return this field-tier matched-band angle for Stage 0.
